y-m-57-03.title: Indawo yegadi yemifuno xa ubude bocingo bumisiwe
y-m-57-03.topic: Eyona inkulu yomsebenzi we-quadratic noluhlu oluvumelekileyo lwento enokwahluka
y-m-57-03.goal: Hlola ngetheyibhile ukuba eyona inkulu yendawo ebhalwe njengebinzana le-quadratic yenzeka phi, gweba ngokwakho ukuba indawo yeyona inkulu inokutshintsha xa imeko entsha itshintsha uluhlu lwento enokwahluka, uze wakhe izisombululo ngaphakathi koluhlu ngokwakho.
y-m-57-03.material: Ufuna ukwenza igadi yemifuno enemilo enxande usebenzisa icala elinye ledonga. Akukho cingo luhamba ecaleni ledonga, kwaye usebenzisa yonke i-20 m yocingo kumacala amathathu amanye. Ukuba amacala amabini ame nkqo kudonga nganye ubude x m, ngoko icala eliyafana nodonga li-(20−2x) m. Ngoko indawo yegadi yi-x(20−2x) m², kwaye apha 0<x<10.
y-m-57-03.thinking.0: Qikelela apho eyona inkulu ikhona usebenzisa itheyibhile
y-m-57-03.thinking.1: Lungisa isigwebo sakho ngokubonisa indlela imeko entsha etshintsha ngayo uluhlu lwento enokwahluka
y-m-57-03.thinking.2: Fumana amaxabiso anelisa iimeko ezimbini ngaxeshanye

y-m-57-03.s.s1.prompt: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, jonga ulwazi olutsha uze ukhethe isigwebo sakho malunga no-x owenza indawo ibe yeyona inkulu.

y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala imeko entsha njengokungalingani ku-x uze uqale umisele uluhlu olunokwenzeka luka-x.

y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Indawo itshintsha njani njengoko wenza u-x abe mkhulu ukusuka ku-0 uye ku-10?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Xa icala elinye liba lide, elinye liba lifutshane, ngoko awunakugqiba ngempembelelo yecala elinye kuphela. 'b' luqikelelo kwaye 'd' sisigwebo sokuhlolwa ngetheyibhile. Masihlole ngetheyibhile.

y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Iba ncinci ekuqaleni, emva koko ikhula kwakhona

y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Itheyibhile inamaxabiso alinganayo ngasekhohlo nangasekunene ku-5 (4 no-6 banika u-48, 3 no-7 banika u-42). Ngoko u-5 ngowona ukhethiweyo omkhulu. Ukuba ubhala kwakhona ibinzana njenge-−2(x−5)²+50, ungaqinisekisa ukuba nakwi-x enedesimali, u-50 kwi-5 yeyona inkulu.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ndigwebe ukuba inkulu xa x=5 (phakathi kwamaxabiso aphelele akwitheyibhile, u-5 yeyona inkulu nayo)
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Isondele kwi-x=5, kodwa kusekudala ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo phambi kokuhlola amaxabiso edesimali
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ulwazi olutsha: udonga apho uza kubeka le gadi lu-8 m kuphela ubude. Icala eliyafana nodonga, (20−2x), alinakugqitha kwi-8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngoku, phakathi kwamaxabiso anokwenzeka ka-x, ungalugweba njani ixabiso elinika indawo enkulu kakhulu?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukusuka ku-20−2x≤8, x kufuneka abe ngu-6 ubuncinane. Ukuba x=5, icala eliyafana li-10 m, elide kunodonga, ngoko akunakwenzeka. Kwi-x≥6, okukhona u-x enkulu, kokukhona indawo incinci, ngoko u-48 kwi-x=6 yeyona inkulu. Incopho yebinzana (x=5) inokuba ngaphandle koluhlu olunokwenzeka.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.reflect: Xa kuvela imeko entsha, akuthethi ukuba isigwebo sakho sangaphambili (x=5) sasingalunganga; 'uluhlu olunokwenzeka luka-x' lutshintshile, ngoko indawo yeyona inkulu inokutshintsha. Chaza ukuba yeyiphi inkcazelo etshintshe isigwebo sakho, okanye ukuba ubunokuyishiya injalo.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.prompt: Phantsi kwemeko yokuba udonga lu-8 m, fumana amaxabiso ama-3 ahlukeneyo ka-x apho indawo ingu-46 m² okanye ngaphezulu. (x unokuba lidesimali.)

y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana indawo kwi-x=6, uze unyuse u-x kancinci kancinci uze ubone ukuba indawo itshintsha njani.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c1: U-x mkhulu kuno-0 kwaye mncinci kuno-10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c1: U-x kufuneka abe mkhulu kuno-0 kwaye abe mncinci kuno-10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Icala eliyafana nodonga li-8 m okanye ngaphantsi.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Icala eliyafana nodonga, (20−2x), lingaphezulu kwe-8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Indawo incinci kuno-46 m². Phindaphinda u-x no-w.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka kwimeko yodonga, x≥6, kwaye ukusuka kwimeko yendawo x(20−2x)≥46, u-x ungama-6.41 okanye ngaphantsi. Ngoko amaxabiso aphakathi kwe-6≤x≤6.41 yimpendulo. Kwi-x=6.5 indawo yi-45.5, engonelanga.

y-m-57-01.title: Ukuhambelana okune: ngawaphi imisebenzi?
y-m-57-01.topic: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi: ukuhambelana ngesiphumo esinye kwi-input nganye
y-m-57-01.goal: Gweba ukuhambelana ngomgangatho 'wesiphumo esinye kwi-input nganye', ubonise ngemizekelo oyakhayo ukuba ii-input ezahlukeneyo zinokuba nesiphumo esifanayo kwaye ngokunjalo ngumsebenzi, uze uthi ungalungisa njani ukuhambelana okungengomsebenzi ukuze kube ngumsebenzi.
y-m-57-01.material:
Xa kukho ukuhambelana (umthetho), sifuna ukujonga ukuba siphuma siphi isiphumo kwi-input enye. Zikho ukuhambelana okune ngezantsi.
(가) Kumfundi ngamnye eklasini, abela inani lakhe lokuhlala. (Amanani okuhlala sele emisiwe.)
(나) Kwinani eliphelele elipositive x, abela abahlulayo abapositive be-x.
(다) Kwinani eliphelele x, abela isikwere se-x.
(라) Kwinani lokwenyani x le-0 okanye ngaphezulu, abela "inani lokwenyani y elinesikwere salo silingana ne-x."

y-m-57-01.thinking.2: Lungisa ukuhambelana okungengomsebenzi ngokutshintsha iimeko zako ukuze kube ngumsebenzi

y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwindlela nganye yokuhambelana, khetha ii-input ezimbini okanye ezintathu wenze itheyibhile ye-"input → isiphumo", uze ukhangele imiqolo apho ii-input zifana okanye iziphumo zifana.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.a: Olu luvo lubale, omnye ngomnye, ukuba i-input nganye (umfundi) inazo ziphi iziphumo (amanani).
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.b: (나) inani eliphelele elipositive x → abahlulayo abapositive be-x
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.b: Bala ukuba ziphuma zingaphi iziphumo kwi-input 6. Umgangatho kukuba likhona na nokuba li-input elinye elineziphumo ezininzi.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.c: Olu luvo luhlukanise ukuba ii-input ezahlukeneyo (umzekelo 2 no-−2) ziyavunyelwa ukuba zibe nesiphumo esifanayo ngomgangatho wokuba i-input nganye inaziphi iziphumo.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.d: (라) inani lokwenyani x le-0 okanye ngaphezulu → y esikwere sayo yi-x

y-m-57-02.title: Ukuhlolisisa isitatimenti esithi 'ukuba ithe nkqo ngakumbi, ithambeka likhulu'
y-m-57-02.topic: Ithambeka lomsebenzi othe tye: uphawu nokuthe nkqo
y-m-57-02.goal: Yazi ukuba 'ithe nkqo ngakumbi' no 'ithambeka likhulu' asoloko ethetha into enye, fumana uze ulungise umgca ongachanekanga kwimeko ethelekisa iithambeka ezineempawu ezahlukileyo, uze wakhe umzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-57-02.material: Iigrafu zemisebenzi emibini ethe tye y=2x kunye no-y=−3x zizotyiwe kwi-plane enye yeekhowudinethi. Igrafu ye-y=2x inyuka ngasekunene, kwaye igrafu ye-y=−3x ihla ngasekunene. Ithambeka 'lutshintsho luka-y xa x enyuka nge-1'. Ngezantsi sisicatshulwa apho umfundi athelekise iithambeka ezimbini.

y-m-57-02.thinking.2: Chaza iimeko apho ukuqhubela phambili kusebenza khona

y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlela umgca ngamnye ube 'sisibakala esifundwa kwigrafu okanye ulingano' okanye 'sisibakala esenziwe kumgaqo'.

y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.0: Kwi-y=2x, xa x enyuka nge-1, u-y wenyuka nga-2.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.1: Kwi-y=−3x, xa x enyuka nge-1, u-y wehla nga-3.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.2: Igrafu ethe nkqo ngakumbi inethambeka elikhulu.

Ukuthe nkqo kuthelekisa amaxabiso aphelele eethambeka (3 no-2), ngelixa ubukhulu bethambeka, kubandakanya uphawu, buthelekisa u-−3 no-2. Umgca 4 sisiphumo nje sokusebenzisa umgca 3, kwaye kumgca 5, u-−3 ungasekhohlo ku-2 kumgca wamanani, ngoko −3<2.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi ethe tye ye-3 eyahlukileyo y=ax+b ethe nkqo ngakumbi kuno-y=2x kodwa enethambeka elincinci. Ukunqumla ku-y (b) kufuneka kube ngu-1.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale kwakhona 'ethe nkqo ngakumbi' usebenzisa ixabiso eliphelele lethambeka, uze ufumane uluhlu kumgca wamanani olwanelisa oko kunye ne 'thambeka lincinci'.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.1: Xa ukhethe a, hlola iimeko ezimbini ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ithe nkqo ngakumbi kuno-y=2x (ixabiso eliphelele lethambeka likhulu kuno-2).
y-m-57-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuze ibe nkqo ngakumbi, ixabiso eliphelele lethambeka kufuneka libe likhulu kuno-2, kwaye ithambeka kufuneka libe ngaphantsi kwe-2, ngoko a kufuneka abe ngaphantsi kwe-−2. Imizekelo: y=−3x+1, y=−5x+1, y=−2.5x+1. a=3 unethambeka elikhulu nalo, ngoko asingumzekelo ochasayo.

y-m-57-04.title: Ukwazi ukuphakama kwerampu
y-m-57-04.topic: Imilinganiselo ye-trigonometric: ukufana konxantathu abane-engile engqukuva nolwazi lobude
y-m-57-04.goal: Gweba ukuba yeyiphi inkcazelo eyaneleyo ukumisela ukuphakama konxantathu one-engile engqukuva njengexabiso elinye, uze uqinisekise ngemizekelo oyakhayo ngokwakho ukuba ukuba i-engile ifanayo, imilinganiselo yamacala iyafana nokuba ubude buyahluka.
y-m-57-04.material: Ufuna ukubeka irampu ethe tye ukusuka emhlabeni othe tyaba ukuya kwisango lesakhiwo. Isiphelo esingezantsi sirampu sichukumisa umhlaba kwaye esiphezulu sichukumisa umgangatho wesango, kwaye isango liphakame nge-h m ngaphezu komhlaba.
